study type: Prospective controlled phase IV non-inferiority interventional trial
exposure: Combined oxytocin regimen (10 IU IM and 10 IU IV)
outcome: Severe postpartum blood loss (defined as delta hemoglobin >=30 g/L)
Postpartum hemorrhage (defined as estimated blood loss >=1000 mL)
cohort: 550 women undergoing elective cesarean section after 36 completed weeks of gestation at low risk for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH).
finding: Combined (IM/IV) oxytocin is not non-inferior to carbetocin regarding severe postpartum blood loss defined as postpartum Hb decrease >=30 g/L in elective cesarean sections.
